description: Slender cantilever, small transverse pluck, release, no gravity. Fundamental frequency vs the Euler-Bernoulli analytical value. The pluck is prescribed as an initial VELOCITY profile shaped like the first bending mode, not an initial displacement, so that frame 0 positions remain exactly the shipped rest configuration (the frozen initial-positions contract of SPEC.md section 3). A velocity pluck excites the same fundamental and any residual higher-mode content is rejected by the FFT peak pick.

initial_conditions.formula: vy(x) = V * phi1(x/L) / phi1(1), phi1(s) = cosh(b*s) - cos(b*s) - sigma*(sinh(b*s) - sin(b*s)), b = 1.875104, sigma = (cosh(b) - cos(b)) / (sinh(b) + sin(b))

provenance.reference_formula: f1 = (1.875104^2 / (2*pi*L^2)) * sqrt(E*I / (rho*A)), I = w*h^3/12 for bending across h
regime_assumptions: small deflection (tip deflection under 5 percent of length, enforced by the scorer as a regime guard)
linear elastic, no damping specified (measured decay is numerical dissipation, report-only)
provenance.notes: Young's modulus enters the formula directly. No plane-strain E/(1-nu^2) correction is applied because the beam's lateral faces are free, which is the uniaxial-stress condition Euler-Bernoulli assumes.
